title: EchoTab: Learning Measurement-Grounded Representations for Echocardiographic Diagnosis through Tabular Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.13599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diagnostic information in multi-view medical imaging studies, like echocardiography, is distributed across views, each capturing different aspects of cardiac structure and function. In clinical practice, these views are first interpreted through quantitative measurements, which then support specific diagnoses. However, existing echo representation learning methods do not explicitly model measurements as an intermediate representation between views and diagnosis. As a result, individual measurements are not explicitly represented in a form that downstream diagnostic tasks can selectively use, hindering accurate diagnosis.   Inspired by this hierarchical clinical workflow, we introduce EchoTab, a measurement-grounded representation learning framework that represents multi-view echocardiography studies using measurement-specific tokens as an intermediate representation between echo views and diagnosis. translated_title: EchoTab：通过表格重建学习以测量为基础的超声心动图诊断表示
translated_abstract: 在超声心动图等多视角医学影像检查中，诊断信息分布于各个视角之中，每个视角捕捉心脏结构与功能的不同方面。在临床实践中，这些视角首先通过定量测量进行解读，进而支持具体诊断。然而，现有的超声心动图表示学习方法并未将测量显式建模为视角与诊断之间的中间表示。因此，单项测量无法以下游诊断任务可有选择性地利用的形式得到显式表示，从而阻碍了准确诊断。受这一分层临床工作流程的启发，我们提出了EchoTab，一个以测量为基础的表示学习框架，它使用测量特定的token（标记）作为超声视角与诊断之间的中间表示，来表征多视角超声心动图检查。每个测量token可选择性地……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: EchoTab提出了一种以测量为基础的表示学习框架，将测量特定的token作为超声视角与诊断之间的中间表示，并通过表格重建任务学习测量基础表示，从而提升多视角超声心动图诊断的准确性。
en_tdlr: EchoTab is a measurement-grounded representation learning framework that uses measurement-specific tokens as an intermediate representation between echo views and diagnosis, learned through tabular reconstruction, to improve multi-view echocardiographic diagnosis.
